SOURCE-RIGHTS-REVIEW.description: Trace retained PMDay/native components, the R13 source and approved S04, its article/infographic additions and source caveats. Preserve licensing and provenance boundaries; no new scientific or institutional endorsement is asserted.

REQUIREMENTS-REVIEW.description: Completed distinct nonauthor Requirements & Acceptance execution on original intent/current ACs and the final candidate, with actual isolation launch, prompt/packet/source identities and first-result receipt.

CODE-ARTIFACT-REVIEW.description: Completed distinct nonauthor Code/changed-artifact execution inspecting actual helper/native sources and diff, dependency preservation, readability, relevant CS rules and check implementation. Do not substitute the implementer review.

WHITEBOX-QA.description: Completed distinct nonauthor White-box QA execution with structural risks, independent oracles, bounded actual checks and exact source/results; distinguish inspection from execution and uncovered scope.

DELIVERY-LINKAGE.description: Observe actual R6 PPTX/PDF/notes/manifest/source files and hashes in an issue109-linked commit on existing Draft PR110. Verify immutable predecessor bytes and distinguish repository delivery from merge, selection and release.

QR-REVIEW.description: Decode the one final homepage QR from native and final PDF raster to exactly https://vitaliioborskyi.ai/, inspect the readable URL and preserve actual decoded-image/source identities. Projector distance remains AC06.
